attributes.title: MASCA Conference 2027: Navigating the Waves of Innovation
attributes.summary:
The Massachusetts School Counselors Association meets on April 5 and 6, 2027, at the Renaissance Framingham Hotel & Conference Center, west of Boston. The theme is "Navigating the Waves of Innovation," and Terri Tchorzynski gives the April 6 keynote, "Courageous Redesign: Designing Proactive Systems for Stronger Student Outcomes." A pre-conference is offered on the first day, and the main conference can also be followed virtually.

In-person registration costs $225 for professional members, $115 for student members and $285 for non-members through January 31, 2027, then $249, $140 and $305 until the advance deadline of April 1. Virtual access is cheaper ($130 to $145 for members, $200 to $215 for non-members), and retiree members get a reduced rate. The pre-conference is priced separately.

The hotel block is $175 per night until March 5, 2027. The conference page does not list PDPs, NBCC hours or other continuing education credit, so Massachusetts school counselors who need PDPs for license renewal should confirm with MASCA before registering.
